definitions.explanation: One of the twelve divisions of a year.

examples.japanese: {来月|らいげつ}{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}す。
{満月|まんげつ}が{見|み}えます。
examples.english: I can see the full moon.

examples.japanese: {月|つき}の{光|ひかり}が{明|あか}るい。
{今夜|こんや}は{月|つき}が{出|で}ていない。
{月|つき}を{見|み}ながら{散歩|さんぽ}した。
examples.english: I took a walk while looking at the moon.

examples.japanese: {今月|こんげつ}は{忙|いそが}しい。
{一|ひと}{月|つき}に{一回|いっかい}{会|あ}います。
{先月|せんげつ}{日本|にほん}に{行|い}きました。
examples.english: I went to Japan last month.

examples.japanese: {何|なん}{月|がつ}に{生|う}まれましたか。
examples.english: What month were you born in?

notes:
{月|つき} has two meanings: the moon (celestial body) and month (time period).

READINGS:
- つき: standalone word (moon, month)
- がつ/げつ: in compounds for months

MOON PHASES:
- {満月|まんげつ}: full moon
- {新月|しんげつ}: new moon
- {三日月|みかづき}: crescent moon
- {半月|はんげつ}: half moon

MONTH EXPRESSIONS:
- {今月|こんげつ}: this month
- {先月|せんげつ}: last month
- {来月|らいげつ}: next month
- {毎月|まいつき}: every month
- {一|ひと}{月|つき}: one month (duration)

CULTURAL NOTE:
{月見|つきみ} (moon viewing) is a traditional autumn activity. {十五夜|じゅうごや} refers to the harvest moon viewing festival.

IDIOM:
{月|つき}が{綺麗|きれい}ですね - "The moon is beautiful" (famously associated with expressing love indirectly).
